quotes.text: Dr. Hooker would perhaps correct the Botanical Part probably——he would do as Editor—— Dr Hooker would be very good
Hooker by far best man to edit my Species volume | Aug. 1854

records.content_assessment: This is Darwin's outgoing contingency request to Emma concerning posthumous editing and publication of his species-theory sketch. Paragraph 3 names Hooker as a possible botanical editor; the 1854 cover annotation is a later research/date layer. The enclosure mentioned in editorial footnote 10 is not present, so no enclosure-based prompt can be reconstructed.

quotes.text: I am anxious for the post today to hear how you are & how the chicks are.
